info.title: cleanr
info.description: Recursively clean bin/obj and optionally node, Cargo, Go, Yarn, pip, uv, publish, artifacts, Visual Studio .vs caches, and NuGet caches. --all turns every opt-in on.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List directories but don't actually delete them.

options.name: --node
options.description: Opt-in to clean node_modules directories and the npm and pnpm caches.

options.name: --dotted
options.description: Opt-in to clean inside hidden directories.

options.name: --vs
options.description: Opt-in to clean .vs directories (Visual Studio caches).

options.name: --rust
options.description: Opt-in to clean Cargo target directories and the CARGO_HOME registry and git caches.

options.name: --nuget
options.description: Opt-in to clean NuGet http-cache and global-packages directories.

options.name: --go
options.description: Opt-in to clean the Go build cache and module cache.

options.name: --yarn
options.description: Opt-in to clean the user-level Yarn cache.

options.name: --pip
options.description: Opt-in to clean the pip cache.

options.name: --uv
options.description: Opt-in to clean the uv cache.

options.name: --all
options.description: Turn on node, dotted, publish, artifacts, vs, rust, nuget, go, yarn, pip, and uv.
